credit.title: L'Appel
credit.description:
When duty calls and the Departed need to form ranks, who will heed the call?

"L'appel" explores order in the chaos of a battlefield - making sense of the unknown and fleeting world that lies beyond. Randomness, repetition, grids and overarching shapes pull the colors around, hoping to find a sense of wonder through the void.

Following "Décorés", the final act of the Departed series reflects on the fleeting nature of existence, inviting viewers to contemplate how our struggles give shape and meaning to our time on earth.
